about.title: Food chemistry in service of public health.
about.bio: Dr. Büşra Yusufoğlu is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Chemistry at Istanbul Technical University. Her research focuses on advanced glycation end products (AGEs), functional foods, food chemistry, analytical chemistry, and AI-supported nutrition science. With extensive research experience at home and abroad, she has been a visiting researcher at prestigious institutions including the University of Connecticut (2021) and Leibniz University Hannover (2024).

teaching.title: Teaching
teaching.subtitle: Courses, mentoring, and teaching philosophy.
teaching.philosophy: When teaching chemistry and food science, I aim for students to see both molecular-level processes and how this knowledge translates into food safety, functional foods, and public health. My courses emphasize analytical thinking, reading the literature, and evidence-based decision-making, so students experience theory and practice together.
